verdicts.note: Adverse-event incidence and costs.

NULL RESULT: SSRI use NOT associated with impaired semen parameters, in Urology. Carried deliberately — the mechanism stream's positive findings come from small clinical series and a null in a general urology sample is the publication-bias counterweight. No abstract on the record.

KEY RECORD. RANDOMISED controlled trial of duloxetine on semen parameters. Randomisation removes confounding by indication outright, which nothing in the primary cell manages. The outcome is a semen parameter rather than a fertility quantity, so it prices the mechanism and not the claim.
Bupropion vs amantadine for SSRI-induced dysfunction.

Bidirectional Mendelian-randomisation between mental disorders and infertility in both sexes. Genetic instruments for the DISORDER, which is D.3.a's identification problem solved and B.7's left open — no instrument for the medication.
Arousal difficulties in women in REMISSION, which partly holds depression severity fixed.
Breast cancer cell line; preprint.
Umbrella review of male-infertility risk factors generally. May contain an antidepressant stratum; retrieve only if the mechanism stream is thin.
Cardiac defects. Wall 4.
Weekend drug holidays.
CYP450 interactions.
Venlafaxine XR for anxiety.
Rat epididymis. Wall 7.

KEY MEASUREMENT RECORD. Failure to FILL electronically prescribed antidepressants. Prescription is not dispensing and dispensing is not ingestion; this quantifies the first gap, and every register-based exposure measure in the primary cell inherits it.
Tiagabine switch.
Buspirone augmentation.
Bahrain psychotropic prescribing analysed explicitly for sexual-function implications. Prevalence outside the OECD, weighted by dysfunction liability.
Suicide.
Congenital malformations. Wall 4.
Congenital anomaly. Wall 4 — though the design separates maternal depression from prescription, which is the Wall 1 contrast applied to the wrong outcome.
SPERMICIDAL activity of SSRI molecules in vitro. A direct-contact mechanism distinct from both the behavioural and endocrine pathways v5 names.
Psychoneuroendocrinology, antidepressant medications, mood AND male fertility together. Both exposures named; no abstract on the record.
1981 Fertility and Sterility, psychotropic drugs and human sperm motility. Pre-SSRI era, so the agents are tricyclics and antipsychotics; the earliest mechanism record in the frame.
Medical comorbidity and spermatogenesis generally.
German adolescent outpatient antidepressant treatment from national insurance data.
States the baseline directly: sexual dysfunction is a SYMPTOM of depression in about 70% of presenting patients. That number is the denominator Wall 1 nets against.
Bupropion for depression-related sexual dysfunction.
Heterogeneous intercourse records inside TTP models.
Predictors of conception in subfertile couples.

KEY FOR WALL 1 AT LINK 1. Explicitly discerns psychopathology from antidepressant treatment as causes of sexual dysfunction. The design B.7 needs, executed on the link-1 endpoint rather than on fertility.
Fertility-awareness education and TTP.
Epidemiology, approaches for assessing effects of EXPOSURES on human fertility. The methodological template for exactly this chapter's estimand, written generically.
CME on SSRIs in pregnancy.
Escitalopram-induced HYPERsexuality. A case of the effect running the opposite way; carried because the chapter should not report a uniform sign it does not have.
Myths about infertility.
Heavy metals and female fertility. B.2's exposure.
Sperm chromatin and DNA damage generally. The endpoint the Safarinejad record uses, without the exposure.
Cardiovascular disease.
Long-term fluvoxamine with haematology and biochemistry endpoints; the design is a toxicology dosing study. Wall 7.
Probiotic adjunct for sexual function under SSRIs.

KEY PARAMETER RECORD. AGE-DEPENDENT SEX DIFFERENCES in SSRI treatment prevalence, United States. This is the exact cut the demographic-significance computation needs — prevalence by age and sex, not the adult aggregate — and it is the number v5's 'particularly women' claim should have been checked against.
Translational review of depression, dysfunction and antidepressants together.
Wall 4.
Wall 4.
Fetal SERT modulation and cardiomyopathy. Wall 4, and animal besides.
Duloxetine, escitalopram AND PLACEBO. The placebo arm is the cleanest available separation of drug from disorder at link 1.
Noradrenergic antidepressant safety.
Optimal dosing by age.
Bradycardia.
Bayesian selection of predictors of cycle conception probability, explicitly including behavioural predictors.
Breast cancer cell line; journal version of the bioRxiv record above.

KEY BASELINE RECORD. European Journal of Population: mental disorders and first-, second- and third-BIRTH RATES in Norway. The only record in the frame so far that states the indication's effect in the review's own currency — parity-specific birth rates — rather than in TTP or semen units.

Nationwide cohort of PATERNAL SSRI use and 'adverse health outcomes'. If the outcomes are the offspring's it is Wall 4; if any is a conception or birth-count outcome it is primary. The abstract does not say which.
Menstrual tracking apps and TTP.
Nepali psychiatric outpatient sample. Non-Western link-1 estimate, which the ascertainment literature suggests will differ.
SSRI prevalence among pregnant women 2017-2020. Pregnancy-conditioned, so it understates preconception exposure by exactly the discontinuation effect.
SNRI class comparison.
Impact, effects and treatment review.
Cardiovascular outcomes in 20-64s.
In utero and lactation exposure. Wall 4.
